$comment: SECURITY HEADERS (audit H-14). This file previously contained only the SPA rewrite,
so the management portal shipped with no security headers at all.
WHY Referrer-Policy IS THE IMPORTANT ONE HERE:
the loan-consent link puts the consent TOKEN in the URL path (/consent/<token>), and
that token is the credential for a legally binding document. Without a referrer
policy, every cross-origin subresource the consent page loads — the Google Fonts
stylesheet, the Material Icons font, a Drive/R2 image, an outbound link a member
taps — receives the full URL, token included, in the Referer header. `no-referrer`
stops that leak outright. It is set for the whole origin because the SPA rewrite
means any path can render the consent route.
WHY THE CSP IS Report-Only FOR NOW:
an enforcing CSP that is even slightly wrong takes a screen down silently, and this
portal launches on 25 October. Report-Only gives identical telemetry with zero risk,
so the allowlist can be confirmed against real traffic first. To enforce, rename
`Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only` to `Content-Security-Policy` — the value needs
no other change. Recommended: leave it in Report-Only for about a week, check the
browser console on every screen (especially Consent, Popups, Download Center and
PDF Export), then flip it.
EVERY ALLOWLISTED ORIGIN WAS DERIVED FROM THE SOURCE, NOT GUESSED:
googletagmanager.com    index.html GTM bootstrap
fonts.googleapis.com    index.html stylesheet (style-src)
fonts.gstatic.com       the font files themselves (font-src)
lh3.googleusercontent.com, drive.google.com, drive.usercontent.google.com
driveUrl.js — Drive-hosted popup images, consent photos
and signatures
files-chhath.shaharpura.com  the R2 public bucket (R2_PUBLIC_BASE)
inputtools.google.com   transliterate.js — the Hindi transliteration API
mgmt-chhath.shaharpura.com   the mgmt API Worker (connect-src)
blob:/data:             jsPDF, html2canvas, QR data-URLs, camera capture
'unsafe-inline' is required for script-src by the GTM bootstrap and for style-src
by the inline style={{...}} props used throughout the views. Removing either is a
separate, larger piece of work; it is noted rather than rushed.
api.ipify.org is deliberately ABSENT: that third-party IP lookup was removed in
this same change (audit H-13).
